roles.background: discrete complexity, semi-filter cover graphs, fusion lower bounds
roles.delegated_check: Bind every set operation to Definitions 18--21 and audit the even-even graph-edge hypotheses.
roles.finding: For an even-even child graph edge, the row and column complement traces are required members of any relevant semi-filter and are disjoint from the old odd-odd slice. The proof must not silently extend to mixed-parity edges.

roles.background: LP duality, residual-capacity arguments, structural transfer
roles.delegated_check: Test whether C024 load slack and C041A projection effects can be composed without importing C024's integrality overclaim.
roles.finding: The safe transfer is local: use pair load/tightness from C024 and old-slice projection from C041A. Do not claim an integral approximation or recurrence.

roles.background: finite combinatorics, hostile boundary cases, counterexample design
roles.delegated_check: Attack emptiness, mixed parity, cross terms, and sufficiency overclaims before accepting the local lemma.
roles.finding: If either child generator trace is empty, no semi-filter can be above the edge. Mixed parity introduces old/new cross terms. The proposed parent-intersection condition can only be necessary because unrelated saturated child pairs may still cover K.

roles.background: statement binding, exact quantifiers, proof DAG and checker trust boundaries
roles.delegated_check: Separate the set-theoretic identity, cylinder-load identity, and augmentation corollary into explicit proof obligations.
roles.finding: Required obligations are: cylinder lift is a semi-filter; relevance of lifted old filters; decorated-pair intersection identity; preservation equivalence under projection; tight-load obstruction; empty-intersection corollary. No proof-assistant certificate is available.

roles.background: circuit-lower-bound barriers, prior-art risk, information-gain routing
roles.delegated_check: Assess whether the result materially narrows the amplification search without being mistaken for a root advance.
roles.finding: The useful contribution is an obstruction compression from child saturated-neighbourhood search to parent tight intersections for one parity class. Treat as compositional/representation-level local progress only; external novelty and root value remain unverified.

discussion_synthesis.agreement: Verify the decorated-pair/cylinder-load identity first because it is the cheapest exact discriminator and can rule out broad off-slice witness strategies when a tight disjoint parent pair exists.
discussion_synthesis.strongest_objection: The criterion is conditional and necessary only. Without proving a structural property of the parent tight-pair intersection family, it does not construct an amplifying rule or establish any recurrence.
discussion_synthesis.unresolved_uncertainty: Whether useful parent dual certificates necessarily have, or can be chosen to avoid, tight pairs with small/empty intersections.
discussion_synthesis.recommended_next_action: Truth-check the local decorated-pair lemma under exact Definition-18--21 semantics, record its boundary conditions, then prospectively freeze the child question about the intersection family of tight parent constraints.
